author: Microsoft
description:
When newborn Scout Bradstreet was diagnosed with an aggressive brain tumor, Children's Cancer Institute used genomic analysis and Microsoft Azure to identify a targeted therapy that changed her life. 

Today, Scout is thriving—a result made possible by the Institute’s advanced, data-driven approach. 

Processing nearly a terabyte of data per patient for ~25 patients each week, the Institute uses Azure to reduce 5,000 hours of computation to less than 24 hours, accelerating precision medicine and delivering faster, more personalized cancer care.
title: Children’s Cancer Institute speeds genomic analysis with Azure, giving kids with cancer hope
